{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    R, C = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    # A hollow 3x3 marker: change its center to 7.
    for r in range(R - 2):
        for c in range(C - 2):
            x = grid[r][c]
            if x == bg:
                continue
            if (grid[r][c+1] == x == grid[r][c+2] and
                grid[r+1][c] == x == grid[r+1][c+2] and
                grid[r+2][c] == x == grid[r+2][c+1] == grid[r+2][c+2] and
                grid[r+1][c+1] == bg):
                out[r+1][c+1] = 7
    # Fill the other framed shape's interior with 2, leaving its frame intact.
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row):
        if color == bg:
            continue
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        if (all(grid[r0][c] == color and grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1+1)) and
            all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0, r1+1))):
            for r in range(r0+1, r1):
                for c in range(c0+1, c1):
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out

{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    R, C = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    # For each non-background connected object, identify its bounding box.
    seen = set()
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r,c)]
            seen.add((r,c))
            pts=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); pts.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<R and 0<=xx<C and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in pts); r1=max(y for y,x in pts)
            c0=min(x for y,x in pts); c1=max(x for y,x in pts)
            if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
            # Hollow rectangular outline.
            if not (all(grid[r0][x]==color and grid[r1][x]==color for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                    all(grid[y][c0]==color and grid[y][c1]==color for y in range(r0,r1+1))):
                continue
            fill = 7 if (r1-r0-1 == 1 and c1-c0-1 == 1) else 2
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    if grid[y][x] == bg:
                        out[y][x]=fill
    return out
